subject: maths
question: The company whose production of motorcycles is approximately 12% more than the demand is:
solution:
Demand of motorcycles of company D = 125

Production of motorcycles of company D = 140

so, 12% of 125

⇒ 15

⇒ 125 + 15 

⇒ 140

140 is production of motorcycle of company D.

**∴ The company whose production of motorcycles is approximately 12% more than the demand is D.**
